breaking.change: Closed transmissive volumes refract at both interfaces and use their measured entry-to-exit distance for absorption. Authored thickness and its map now approximate both only where no geometric exit is captured; zero thickness remains a thin wall.
breaking.fix: Review closed glass volumes for the corrected bending and tint. Use attenuationDistance to set absorption in world units; keep thickness and thicknessMap as the fallback for open, off-screen or occluded exits.
